summary: Model artifact + environment: vendor the student checkpoint and the torch dependency as an optional extra
description:
Model home follows the general llm convention: ALL guru fine-tunes live under ~/programs/guru/<model-name>/ (siblings of ~/programs/mistral, ~/programs/gemma4), NOT inside repos — repos carry only the pinned path + sha in config plus a training-card copy.

Naming: <purpose>-v<N>. Seeded 2026-08-13: ~/programs/guru/scorer-v1 (the thin (query,chunk) relevance scorer, 22.7M distill — was "student-3a2" in rellm run dirs; training-card.json inside). Future distills: scorer-v2, etc.

The 4B tagger joins the same home: v3 lands at ~/programs/guru/4b-v3 when it ships (post quarantine/reassign of the v2 tag contamination). v2 currently lives at ~/Work/rellm/out/qwen3-4b-guru/ served by scripts/run-qwen-4b-guru.sh — migrating it is a one-line MODEL_DIR diff in that script, owner's call whether to move v2 or wait for v3.

torch+transformers as an optional dependency group used only by derive_parallels; document the CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 pin and the CPU fallback (~7 min GPU / ~6 min 8-thread CPU int8 full corpus).
